review_basis: Exact primary provision and source-native parameters reviewed independently before class comparison. Component correspondence reviewed following maintainer approval; relationship strength is distinct from lifecycle coverage.
approval: Maintainer approved the concrete two-class/new-family design and instructed proceeding on 27 October 2026. Source access limits remain unchanged; approval is not human verification of external text.

relationships.external_proposition: Protect assertion- and token-signing keys during storage and cryptographic use.
relationships.invariant: Authentication material must remain under authorised custody throughout its lifecycle. Its secret content must not become available to an unauthorised recipient or route, or undergo unauthorised custody-changing modification or replacement. Valid delegation and lifecycle transitions must preserve the applicable protection boundary.
relationships.supported_component: Partial support for signing-key custody within the report’s asymmetric signed-token and federal-environment scope. This does not verify custody rules for ordinary API keys. MUST is a conformance condition under §1.2, not automatic law. Review-stage EXTREQ pending canonical admission.

actors: Identity provider or authorisation server in the report’s federal environment and signed-token scope
conditions: Federally scoped identity/access systems using asymmetric signed tokens or assertions; see §1.1.
qualifications: The mechanism depends on system impact, resource sensitivity and operational environment.
Section 1.2 makes MUST a conformance condition, while conformance remains voluntary absent applicable policy or binding agreement.
Ordinary API keys, symmetric schemes and stateful management are outside the controls’ scope; no direct mapping from these provisions to Moltbook API tokens or DeepSeek API secrets is asserted.

relationships.limitation: Source controls support stated components, not the entire VIGIL recognition contract. Candidate identity and canonical admission remain pending.
relationships.normative_difference: Source-native informative-technical-report with conditional adoption/conformance. VIGIL recognition and legal applicability are independent.
relationships.fc_property: The property by which credentials, bearer tokens, API secrets, private authentication keys and comparable secret material retain their independently established custody and protection boundary during storage, use, transmission, delegation, replacement and retirement. Exposure or acquisition outside that boundary is independently assessable before any later use to impersonate a principal or access a resource.
relationships.strength_reason: The explicit key-protection conformance condition substantially supports the signing-key custody boundary within the report’s narrow asymmetric signed-token scope. It does not extend to ordinary API keys.
